original_prompt: Weathered desert nomad female warrior, wrapped in sun-bleached cloth and bone charms, cracked leather armour, quiet menace in her eyes
prompt: A weathered desert nomad female warrior stands in a neutral frontal pose, arms relaxed at sides, sun-darkened skin with sharp angular features and cold calculating eyes staring directly forward. Layered sun-bleached ivory linen wraps over cracked worn leather armour, stress fractures across the breastplate and pauldrons. Bone charms — carved animal teeth and knuckles strung on sinew — tied into her wrappings and wind-frayed hair. Cracked dry lips, dust settled in skin creases, scarred calloused hands. Vast arid desert behind her, cracked earth, distant rocky mesa silhouettes, sparse blowing sand at ground level.
